title: WorkerRegistration
description: Tracto Common Execution Contract v1.0.1 — capability advertisement message sent by a worker at registration (C4 decision). The capabilityDigest is an integrity hint only; it is not cryptographic proof of worker authenticity — authentication is established via the mutual-TLS or token-authenticated registration channel.

workerId.description: Stable unique identity of the worker. Must not change across restarts of the same logical worker instance.

runtimeType.description: Runtime environment the worker operates in. Must be consistent with the namespace prefixes declared in advertisedCapabilities.

workerVersion.description: Semantic version of the worker software (e.g. 1.2.3).

protocolVersion.description: Wire protocol version in major.minor form (e.g. 1.0).

supportedSchemaMajors.description: List of contract schema major versions this worker supports. Must include the current and/or previous major. Workers supporting only outdated majors will be rejected.

capabilityDigest.description: SHA-256 integrity hint computed over workerId, runtimeType, workerVersion and canonicalized advertisedCapabilities. This is NOT an authentication proof — it is a mutation-detection hint only (see C4 decision, ST1-09-AC03).

hostClass.description: Whether the worker operates in an interactive desktop session or a headless environment.

interactiveSessionId.description: Session identifier for the interactive desktop session. Must be a non-null, non-empty string when hostClass=interactive. Must be null when hostClass=headless (see C4 decision, runtime-type compatibility check 3).

AdvertisedCapabilities.title: AdvertisedCapabilities
AdvertisedCapabilities.description: Namespace-pattern declaration of all action and predicate namespaces this worker supports, plus runtime limits.

actionNamespaces.description: Glob-style namespace patterns covering all action types the worker can execute (e.g. desktop.*, control.*, service.*, value.*). Must be consistent with runtimeType — a browser worker must not declare desktop.* namespaces.

predicateNamespaces.description: Glob-style namespace patterns covering all technical-condition predicate namespaces the worker can evaluate (e.g. desktop.*, api.*).

maxIterations.description: Maximum iteration count the worker enforces for control.repeatBounded steps. Jobs requiring a higher iteration count will not be dispatched to this worker.

WorkerHealth.title: WorkerHealth
WorkerHealth.description: Current health status reported by the worker at registration time.

status.description: Coarse health status of the worker.

detail.description: Optional human-readable description of the health status, e.g. reason for DEGRADED or UNAVAILABLE state.
